app.name: Intlx Asset Manager
app.installation_instructions: Enter the shared secret used by the intlx asset-manager proxy (the same value as Ticket IQ's shared_secret setting). The app cannot load data without it.

shared_secret.label: Shared secret
shared_secret.helpText: Same value as Ticket IQ's shared_secret. Used to sign requests to the asset-manager proxy; never exposed to agents' browsers.
